proposed_widenings.name: DcSource.fixed
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family fits, but the surface cannot represent an item-cast spell that uses a fixed save DC instead of the caster's spell save DC or an innate ability-derived DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast Fireball (save DC 15) from it

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord attunement qualifier
proposed_widenings.justification: The record can say an item requires attunement, but it cannot preserve the narrower attunement prerequisite that only spellcasters can attune.

notes: This otherwise matches the existing magic_item activation shape: charge_pool cap 7, dawn recharge 1d6+1, and last-charge destruction on 1d20=1. I did not author content because any current encoding would mis-state the fixed DC 15 Fireball cast, and requiresAttunement=true would lose the spellcaster-only qualifier.
